summary: Provision 30 PulseTrace analyst seats + SCIM/SSO setup and cost-center invoice tagging
description:
Issue summary:
Request to purchase 30 named analyst seats for a new SaaS analytics vendor (PulseTrace) for the Insights team. Includes requirement for SSO (SAML/SCIM), invoice allocation across two cost centers, and agreement to a 12-month term with an option to extend.

Impact:
Insufficient seats are blocking Q2 analytics rollouts (dashboard access for 8 analysts + 4 recurring contractors). Timely provisioning affects feature launch timelines and external demos. Finance needs invoice tagging to allocate costs correctly for team budgets.

Justification & scope:
- Vendor: PulseTrace (new vendor; product demo completed 2026-03-05)
- Requested seats: 30 named seats (25 full-time, 5 contractor-floating)
- Required integrations: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, audit log export to our SIEM, data residency EU option for subset of accounts
- Contract length: 12 months with auto-renew opt-out; prefer monthly billing but willing to sign annual if discount >10%

Deliverables requested from Procurement/IT/Legal:
1) Negotiate price and standard DPA/SLA clauses (SOC2 Type II evidence required)
2) Set up SAML metadata and SCIM provisioning with onboarding guide for central IT
3) Configure invoice split: 70% cost center FIN-4302, 30% cost center ENG-7741
4) Enable admin roles and seat provisioning for Insights product managers

Timeline:
- Pricing & contract signed: target 2026-03-20
- SSO/SCIM test environment live: target 2026-03-24
- All seats provisioned: target 2026-03-27

Notes: pulse-trace has a 30-day evaluation license that we can extend to complete technical validation. Procurement should request SOC2 report and DPA before procurement execution.
steps_to_reproduce:
N/A - procurement request. Operational steps for IT once contract signed:
1) Procure license keys and confirm seat count with vendor portal
2) Exchange SAML metadata; generate SCIM token; test provisioning with 3 test users
3) Set up group sync mapping for Insights-Analysts and Insights-Contractors
4) Confirm log export endpoint and retention policy with Security
licensing_terms: 12-month term preferred. Ask for early-termination clause and monthly invoicing option. Seek volume discount for annual prepay. Contractor-floating seats must be transferable w/ admin revocation.
cost_center_allocations: 70% FIN-4302; 30% ENG-7741. Finance requested PO + two-line invoice split with clear GL codes.
